verdict.rationale: Penpot explicitly advertises its own open file format alongside open standards like SVG, CSS, HTML and JSON (penpot-docs-21, penpot-docs-36). It is open-source (penpot-docs-16, penpot-gh-1) and expresses design as code readable by external tools and agents (penpot-docs-32), backed by API access to objects and properties (penpot-docs-3). A community user also values that files are not locked in a proprietary silo (penpot-comm-17). Missing for 10: an actual published file-format specification or schema docs, and independent hands-on evidence of tooling the format outside the Penpot editor.
